title: Specified-coefficient degree-p derivation component

from.place: Tag 07PR: derivation detecting the degree-p coefficient

lean.statement:
theorem FormalFiberDegreePDerivation
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (n m : ℕ)
    (q : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k))) [q.IsPrime]
    (L : Type u) [Field L]
    [Algebra ((⊥ : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k))).ResidueField) L]
    [Module.Finite
      ((⊥ : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k))).ResidueField) L]
    [IsPurelyInseparable
      ((⊥ : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k))).ResidueField) L]
    (M : IntermediateField
      ((⊥ : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k))).ResidueField) L)
    [Module.Finite
      ((⊥ : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k))).ResidueField) M]
    [IsPurelyInseparable
      ((⊥ : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k))).ResidueField) M]
    (z : L) (hz : IntermediateField.adjoin M ({z} : Set L) = ⊤)
    (a : M) (ha : z ^ p = (a : L)) (hdeg : Module.finrank M L = p) :
    let A := MvPolynomial (Fin m) (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k)
    let K := (⊥ : Ideal A).ResidueField
    let C := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q))
      (Localization.AtPrime q)
    let R := TensorProduct K M ((⊥ : Ideal A).Fiber C)
    letI : CommSemiring R := (inferInstance : CommRing R).toCommSemiring
    letI : AddCommMonoid R := (inferInstance : CommRing R).toAddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid
    ∃ D : Derivation ℤ R R, IsUnit (D (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom a))

statement: Let k be a field of prime characteristic p, n,m nonnegative, A=k[[x_1,...,x_n]][y_1,...,y_m] [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] [def-weil-polynomial-ring], q a prime of A, K=κ_A(0) its fraction field [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], and C the maximal-ideal-adic completion of A_q [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let L/K be a finite purely inseparable field extension [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension], M an intermediate field finite purely inseparable over K, and z in L such that M(z)=L, z^p equals a specified a in M, and [L:M]=p. Put F=K tensor_A C and R=M tensor_K F [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Let i(a)=a tensor 1 in R. There exists an absolute derivation D:R -> R such that D(i(a)) is a unit. No regularity hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: The power-series coefficient ring is regular local by [lem-weil-pbc-power-series-field-cohen-regular-complete]. The regular-local localization theorem [lem-weil-pbc-regular-local-localization] makes it a regular ring. Mathlib MvPolynomial.isRegularRing_of_isRegularRing makes A regular. Thus every prime localization of A is normal by [lem-weil-pbc-regular-ring-normal]; [lem-weil-pbc-normal-domain-of-local-normal] makes the domain A integrally closed.

Choose the finite A-subalgebra B of M by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-subalgebra-fraction-field]. The specified a is not a pth power in M, since otherwise injectivity of Frobenius gives z in M and degree one. Write a=b/s and put c=s^(p-1)b=s^p a. The element c is not a pth power in M, since division by s would give a root of a.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-derivation-nonzero-on-non-pth-power] to c over the complete local power-series base supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-power-series-field-cohen-regular-complete]. Finiteness of B over A makes it finite type over the base by transitivity. Obtain an absolute derivation D of B with D(c) nonzero.

Apply [new-lem-weil-pbc-finite-model-formal-fiber-derivation-extension] to D. This proved helper combines the unique prime, singleton finite-completion comparison, tensor base change, and three extensions, with explicit agreement on every element of B.

The extended value on c is the image of the nonzero field element D(c), hence a unit. The Leibniz power formula gives E(i(s)^p)=0 in characteristic p. Differentiating c=s^p a shows i(D(c))=i(s)^p E(i(a)); a factor of a unit product is a unit. This reasoning remains valid in the zero ring.
